stateOffline: Not online · last published: v{published} · draft: v{version}
revertedLive: Back to version {n}: version {version} created and online
pinned: Version {n} starred: it will never be deleted
askBody: My theme is online (version {published}). Going back to version {n} creates a new, identical version: nothing is lost.
askHelp: “Go back and publish” puts this look in place for all your visitors right away; “without publishing” keeps it as a draft.
